name: [TEST] Critical: SQL injection scanning campaign against public web apps
description: Automated probing of login and configuration endpoints with sqlmap, attributed to an active exploitation campaign. Covers the maximum-score path: high threat level, MITRE tag multiplier, completed analysis, attribute-level Admiralty tags and true-positive sightings, and a match on every IOC type in the ioc_mapping (ip-src, url, uri, user-agent, http-method).

detection_chain: sql injection pattern in query string

misp_attributes.comment: Scanning source, bulletproof hosting range
Probed endpoint, CMS login
Probed URL carrying an sql injection payload
Probed endpoint, secrets file. Shared with the reconnaissance event to exercise multi-event aggregation
Scanner tool signature
Observed request method
Scanned endpoint

expected_outcome.notes: Matches this event on all IOC types plus the shared '/.env' uri of the reconnaissance event, so score_events aggregates two events via noisy-OR.

name: [TEST] Medium: Directory and method enumeration with Nikto
description: Web server reconnaissance detected through scanner user-agent and uncommon HTTP methods. Covers the path where the alert source IP is unknown to MISP and the match comes from url/uri, user-agent and http-method only, with Admiralty grades inherited from the event (no attribute-level tags) and a false-positive-dominated sighting record.

misp_attributes.comment: Nikto default signature, frequently reported as a false positive
Probed endpoint, secrets file. Shared with the sqlmap campaign event
Probed endpoint, Apache status page
WebDAV method used for enumeration
Source of the reported reconnaissance. Deliberately different from the alert source IP

expected_outcome.notes: No MITRE tag, so no severity multiplier. Admiralty grades resolve from the event-level tags returned as inherited attribute tags.

name: [TEST] High: Exploitation attempts from a public scanning service range
description: Malicious probing originating from an IP that belongs to a known internet-wide scanning service. Covers acceptance criterion 4 together with the rule that a warninglist match must not reduce the score: the source IP is reported in identified-scanners and still contributes to the severity score alongside the user-agent and uri matches, because warninglist enforcement is disabled for this scenario.

misp_attributes.comment: Known public scanning service IP. Reported in identified-scanners and kept in the IOC search results, so it contributes to the score
NSE signature observed in the exploitation attempts
Spring Boot actuator endpoint probed for credential leakage
Path traversal attempt

expected_outcome.identified_scanners: non-empty: 66.240.192.138 maps to the name of the warninglist that contains it
expected_outcome.notes: Requires the corresponding scanning-service warninglist to be enabled in MISP. The severity score must be identical whether or not the warninglist is enabled.

name: [TEST] Undefined: Research scanner inventory
description: Inventory of legitimate internet-wide research scanners, published as research-scanner objects. Covers the search_research_scanner_matches path and acceptance criterion 6: identified-scanners is populated while the severity score stays 0, because the matching event carries an undefined threat level, so no case is created.

expected_outcome.identified_scanners: non-empty: each matched source IP maps to its research-scanner project and domain (e.g. 'PROJECT - Censys Internet-Wide Scanning; DOMAIN - censys.io'), plus any matching warninglist name
expected_outcome.notes: The undefined threat level yields severity 0, so the event contributes 0 to the noisy-OR aggregation and the score stays 0 even though MISP events were found.

name: [TEST] Low: Aggressive SEO crawler enumeration
description: High-volume but benign crawling reported with a weak evidence base. Covers the low end of the scale: low threat level, initial analysis stage, weak Admiralty grades and false-positive-only sightings produce a non-zero score below every configured priority threshold. The alert omits http_method and detection_chain to exercise the optional-field branches.

misp_attributes.comment: Commercial SEO crawler, repeatedly reported as a false positive
Standard crawler entry point
Crawler source address

expected_outcome.notes: The initial analysis stage zeroes the analyst-judgment half of the confidence and the false-positive record zeroes the sightings contribution.

name: [TEST] Undefined: Unrelated scanning campaign, zero-match control
description: Background threat intelligence intentionally sharing no IOC with its own alert data. Covers acceptance criterion 6 in the strict case: no MISP event matches any alert IOC and the source IP is not a known scanning source, so the severity score is 0, identified-scanners is empty and no case is created. The alert carries only the required fields.

misp_attributes.comment: Source of an unrelated campaign
Probed endpoint of an unrelated campaign
Generic client of an unrelated campaign

expected_outcome.notes: misp_events_found must be empty and score_breakdown must contain no event result.
